title: Chi Therapy
text: Having gotten them to join the party, I had them ride the Portal to Siltvelt and Zeltoble, which gave them even more conviction, and Panda's adoptive father and grandfather ended up helping out with various things. When we went to visit the old woman in Melromarc, she was in a stage where illness had weakened her and she was bedridden more often than not, so we treated her with medicine, and she apparently showed real motivation during training with Panda's grandfather. Perhaps that clan is simply built for combat? Father remarked as much, but there's no problem, I say.

“The Heroes' purpose, this one understands now, it does! If this power is to be used for calming the Waves, this one will spare no cooperation. Besides… now that the Spear Hero-sama already knows despite our concealment, there's little point in hiding it any longer.”

She wasn't quite called a saint, but the old woman seemed willing to cooperate all the same. For now, since training couldn't be done within Melromarc, it was decided we'd conduct it in Zeltoble and Panda's village instead, indeed.
“Oh, you there!”
“Huh? Me? You need something?”
Panda and the old woman approached a rabbit man who was reading a book.
“Hmm… I sense talent that would shine if polished.”
“Indeed it does! With proper training, in ten years… no, perhaps a talent born once every hundred years! Come, join our training!”
“Wa-wa-wah! N-no thank you!”

The rabbit man tried to flee at full sprint in a comical panic toward the mixed-breed lizardman, but since the lizardman seemed intent on focusing on his own training, the rabbit man instead ran to Father and used him as a shield. This rabbit man really does seem to use people as shields a lot, doesn't he.
“Ahh… he's currently putting his effort into magic and studies, so I'd appreciate it if you went easy on him.”
“No, his aptitude is more than sufficient. It would be a waste not to polish it.”
“Indeed! We believe he has the aptitude!”
Panda's grandfather reached out toward the rabbit man to check something.
“Hmm… he has the aptitude, but stimulate it carelessly and his constitution might run wild, this…”
“What? Do Demi-Humans have such an issue?”
“Ah, if the factors within the body activate in a bad way, it can only worsen things. But handled well, it can also improve them.”
“Chi therapy, huh—if it's better for Teo's illness than massage, might be worth having him do a bit of it.”
“Ho, then this is perfect timing. Let us drill it into him thoroughly!”
“W-wah, waaaah! Iwatani-samaaaaa!”

And so the rabbit man was hauled off by the old woman and Panda's grandfather. It seems the rabbit man had a decent aptitude for handling chi as well. Still… he's got a bit of that Riska vibe about him in some ways, I say. Though his magical aptitude might be similar, apparently his real strengths lie in light and dark magic. He'd said that as he practiced, those elements simply felt easier to use than the others.

Enough about the rabbit man—the point was that, since we were operating with the goal of rescuing Big Sister and the others, both the old woman and Panda's parents agreed to lend their strength willingly. Once Panda's adoptive father learned of the situation—that we were protecting Big Sister and the others—his attitude softened considerably. Now all that remained was for Panda to join up and help liven up the circus. Panda's grandfather, thinking it looked fun, decided to join Father's planned act ahead of schedule. After consulting with the monster trader and the Siltvelt envoy, it was arranged that he'd officially enter the country from Zeltoble under the guise of a slave, then make his way to Father. Apparently the monster trader used a travel permit to get him through the border fort. At Father's suggestion, Panda's grandfather agreed to take on the role of clown. Much like Panda, he seemed to entertain the crowd by throwing daggers at targets and bounding about. And it was decided that once his grandchild Panda arrived, the role would be handed over. Father, who hadn't yet met Panda, remarked that the grandfather turned out to be surprisingly mischievous—or rather, quite the daredevil.
『Don't you dare set up a siege around me!』

My mental image of Panda broke out in a cold sweat, packing up belongings and preparing to flee—but why would that be? Surely it's just my imagination. Now that family backing had been secured, this time the negotiations were bound to succeed. Before Rival arrived, I'd have Older Sister get along nicely with Father alongside her. Now then, Panda—wherever you've run off to for work, hurry on back, I say.

And so, with all that going on, the Wave in Melromarc was drawing steadily closer. Father's circus business had reached the stage of getting fairly well established. By entrusting the bioplants I'd secured to Lazy Pig's family home and having them distributed to various regions, the food problem was gradually being resolved bit by bit, and along with that, more people had begun coming to the circus. Meanwhile, Big Sister and the others, wanting to help out with the circus, were now doing juggling and the like alongside Filolial-sama.
“Yaaay, riding Keel-kun while singing and dancing~”
“You're not really riding me, Luna-chan, you're just perching me on your hand and rubbing me all over! Ahh, I wanted to walk the tightrope for once!”
“It's fine, Keel-kun rides on Luna's head while Luna walks the rope~”

So, having secured Luna-chan's egg, once it hatched and was raised up, around the same time Keel—with Older Sister's help—had also managed to turn from pig into dog, I say. Over in Zeltoble, Luna-chan joined in on Keel's practice, walking a rope in Filolial-sama form. Naturally, with Keel perched atop her head.
“That's a form of acrobatics in its own right, I'd say~”

Father analyzed the Keel-and-Luna-chan tightrope act in his usual way. With that acrobatics slot filled, it seemed Zeltoble too was starting to resemble a proper fixed circus. Big Sister and the others brought in tips day after day, showing Older Sister and Father that they too could pull their weight. And the girls were out hunting to level up, led along by the Filolial-sama waiting in Zeltoble and by Older Sister. Father, meanwhile, was also using the opportunity to strengthen the girls further, honing their skills to the point where they could hold their own in a fight if it came down to it.
“Naofumi-samaaa~”
“Naofumi-samaaa~”
Big Sister's friend and Big Sister came pushing along a coffin-like box.
“What's up, Raphtalia-chan and everyone?”
“Um, so. Everyone worked together to make this—look! Do you think this could help out with the circus?”

With that, Big Sister's friend climbed into the box and opened the face panel to show she was inside. Then Big Sister slid a board into the box from outside, shifting the same section sideways. Ah, that's the one—the zigzag box trick, I say.
“Ah, that's got a magic-show feel to it. Well, I suppose a circus might have something like that too.”
Still, it was a bit of a different flavor from the kind of circus Father was running.
“You all worked really hard on this. Everyone's been studying so much. I'm happy too, you know.”
Father praised the hardworking Big Sister and the others.
“Really?”
“Yeah. Pretty soon I think I'll have Raphtalia-chan and the others take on bigger, main roles.”
“Yes!”
“We'll do our best!”
The girls answered energetically, while Father wore a rather complicated smile.
“Hmm… maybe an explosion trick would actually suit Raphtalia-chan better after all?”
Big Sister's friend, sensing Father's reaction, offered up some kind of suggestion.
“You mean the one where the box explodes and then you escape from it? The one Sadeena-oneesan stopped us from doing.”

Oh my… so Big Sister and the others had been cooking up quite the extreme trick after all. According to Older Sister, apparently it hadn't been built properly, and if actually performed, it would've turned into a genuinely dangerous stunt—hence why she'd stopped them. Older Sister can apparently tell the internal structure just from sound waves.
“Hmm. I think that one's a bit too dangerous unless Raphtalia-chan and the others have someone more experienced build it, rather than making it themselves~”
“Then how about the idea where Spear Hero-sama vanishes from the box with no trick or gimmick at all?”
“Shall we give it a go? I could escape from an exploding box with no trick or gimmick whatsoever, I say. With spear skills, anything's possible, I say.”
Phasing through the wall with Soul Eater Spear while escaping via Cloaking Lance would do the trick nicely.
“Hmm… so it comes down to sheer weapon power, huh—in that case, maybe I could hold the bomb myself and just endure it as a spectacle~”
“Father could definitely pull that off without fail, I say.”
“Except… if I show off being too ridiculously tough, the Three Heroes Church might get suspicious, which could be risky~ Hmm. Let's think it over carefully, okay?”
“Okay~”
“Yay, Raphtalia-chan.”
“Yeah.”
And so, well… Father went along with Big Sister's enthusiasm, letting off a bit of steam in the process. Some of it did apparently get adopted into the circus act.
“Whoa! Luna-chan! Quit using me for weightlifting!”
“Keel-kun's fluffy~”
“Don't sniff my stomach! You're doing that on purpose, Luna-chan! Hey!”
Right alongside Father and the others' exchange, Keel was being doted on by Luna-chan.
